text:
Predicates:
F1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student.
NeedsToApplyForCPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
NeedsToApplyForOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
WantsToWorkInUS(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
Mike ::: the individual named Mike.

Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → (F1(x) ∨ J1(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) ∧ F1(x) ∧ WantsToWorkInUS(x)) → (NeedsToApplyForCPT(x) ∨ NeedsToApplyForOPT(x)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa who wants to work in the US needs to apply for CPT or OPT.
InternationalStudent(Mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
NeedsToApplyForCPT(Mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.

Conclusion:
J1(Mike) ::: Mike has a J1 visa.
